```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)

ggplot2::theme_set( councilR::council_theme(use_showtext = TRUE))
```

```{r setup}
library(ghg.sp)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
bau_summary <- scenario_results(.scenario = "BAU",
                                .electric_scenario = "ER",
                                .aeo_scenario = "REF"
                              )

```

```{r}
alternate_scenario <- scenario_results(
  .scenario = "MIT",
  .electric_scenario = "ER",
  .aeo_scenario = "REF",
  .drs_fuel_type = "BEV",
  .av_pct = 5,
  .av_fuel_type = "BEV"
)
```

```{r}
bind_rows(
bau_summary$passenger$PLDV$vmt %>% 
  filter(ctu == "St. Paul"),

alternate_scenario$passenger$PLDV$vmt %>% 
  filter(ctu == "St. Paul")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = vmt,
             shape = class,
             color = scenario)) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_discrete(labels = c("Battery electric",
                                 "Diesel",
                                 "Hybrid electric",
                                 "Plug-in Hybrid",
                                 "Gasoline"))

```

```{r}
bau_summary$passenger$BU_BRT$vmt %>% 
    filter(mode == "BU",
         ctu == "St. Paul",
         class == "BCI")  %>% 
      mutate(vmt = vmt / 10^5)


```
